p.espaces.rg_t: ⚖️ The rules of trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_d: Customs, product standards, starting a business, investment platforms: official sources of each country.
p.espaces.rg_sub: The rules change often: ONE WORLD does not copy them, it opens up to date official sources, then you read them in your language.
p.espaces.rg_g1: Global Trade Helpdesk (ITC, UNCTAD, WTO): for a product and a country, duties, taxes, rules and procedures on one page
p.espaces.rg_g2: Market access map (MAP): customs duties and rules of origin
p.espaces.rg_g3: ePing (WTO): standards, labelling and health rules that this country is putting in place for products
p.espaces.rg_e1: Access2Markets: Trade with and from the EU, step by step
p.espaces.rg_e2: TARIC: Customs Code and duties on entry into the EU
p.espaces.rg_b1: Business Ready (World Bank): starting a business, taxes, international trade, country by country
p.espaces.rg_i1: I-SCAN (IOSCO): check that a platform has not been reported by a regulator before entrusting money to it
p.espaces.rg_note: A site opens in its own language: use your browser's translation, or "Understanding a document" for a document in your own language. For an important decision, ask for advice from a local professional
p.espaces.cu_d: Obligations, documents, Incoterms, free official tools, forwarders and carriers.
p.espaces.cu_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not make customs declarations: an authorized customs broker (freight forwarder) can do it for you. You can also ask your customs broker to make customs declarations.
p.espaces.cu_t1: Market access map (ITC, UN-WTO): duties and rules for almost all countries
p.espaces.cu_t2: Access2Markets (European Union): customs duties, taxes, rules of origin, step by step
p.espaces.cu_t3: TARIC: Customs code (HS code) and duties on entry into the European Union
p.espaces.cu_t4: French Customs: EORI, customs clearance, simulators
p.espaces.cu_d3: Shipping document: Bill of Lading (Sea), Air Waybill (Air), CMR (Road)
p.espaces.cu_d4: Certificate of origin (to obtain reduced duties)
p.espaces.cu_d5: EORI number (companies that import or export in the EU)
p.espaces.cu_d6: Depending on the product: sanitary or phytosanitary certificate, license, CE standards
p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer manages everything from seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: the seller delivers the goods cleared for export to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: Seller loads on ship; after that, risks and costs are borne by buyer.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: the seller pays the transport and insurance costs to the port of arrival.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: the seller delivers at destination, the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: the seller pays everything, including import duties.
p.espaces.cu_ban: Banned or controlled everywhere: weapons, drugs, counterfeits, protected species (CITES), some medicines. Such lists are refused and can be reported (er).
p.espaces.cu_src: Sources: ICC (Incoterms 2020), ITC, European Commission, douane.gouv.fr Always check the exact rules for your product.

p.espaces.mt_d: Western Union, MoneyGram, Wise, Remitly… compare the fees for your country before sending.
p.espaces.mt_sub: 24/24 ONE WORLD does not send money itself and does not earn anything from these links: you compare here, then you send with the service you choose.
p.espaces.mt_wb: Remittance costs worldwide (World Bank): the actual cost of sending money, country by country, service by service
p.espaces.mt_p_wu: Cash withdrawal in many countries, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_mg: Cash pickup, bank transfer, mobile wallet
p.espaces.mt_p_wise: Bank transfer at market exchange rate, fees are displayed before you send
p.espaces.mt_p_rem: Bank transfer, mobile wallet, withdrawal of funds
p.espaces.mt_p_wr: Mobile wallet, bank transfer, cash pickup
p.espaces.mt_p_tt: Send to a mobile wallet or bank account
p.espaces.mt_k1: Look at the total received: fee + exchange rate. A rate worse than the market rate is a hidden cost.
p.espaces.mt_k2: Choose how the person receives it: in cash, bank account or mobile wallet (M-Pesa, Orange Money, MTN…).
p.espaces.mt_k3: An ID is often required, both for sending and for withdrawing.
p.espaces.mt_k4: Don't send money to someone you've met only online, or to "unlock" a prize, package, loan, or visa: it's almost always a scam.
p.espaces.mt_note: Services and prices change: always check on their website when you send.
p.espaces.ds_d: Selling without stock: find a supplier, calculate the real price, stay in the law.
p.espaces.ds_sub: Dropshipping means selling a product that the supplier ships directly to your customer. Easy to get started, but you remain responsible for the sale.
p.espaces.ds_s1: Choose a product that is authorized in your customers’ country: no counterfeits, no unauthorized regulated products.
p.espaces.ds_s2: Find a supplier ("Wholesale / supplier" listings here or wholesale platforms) and order a sample before selling.
p.espaces.ds_s3: Calculates the actual price: product, delivery, customs duties, VAT of the customer's country, payment fees and returns.
p.espaces.ds_s4: Inform your customers of the actual delivery time.
p.espaces.ds_s5: Register your business: company status, VAT and taxes according to your country (see Business rules).
p.espaces.ds_s6: Respecting consumer rights: clear prices including taxes, right of return, guarantee, data protection.
p.espaces.ds_w1: A supplier who wants full payment by unsecured bank transfer or in cryptocurrency.
p.espaces.ds_w2: Paid races that promise to make you rich quickly.
